about: WD1's reviewed map from Wikidata P31 classes to the canonical site types (pipeline/normalizers/site_type.py). kind: site = a kind of site, consistent with the listed types; generic = an archaeological or heritage class that confirms only the generic types it lists; container = the item is a settlement, administrative unit, natural feature, park or museum - the site is in doubt unless the stored type is one listed; other = the item is no place at all (an object, a person, a deity, a concept, a Wikimedia page). Built 2026-09-26 from the P31 classes of every item in the full harvest (766 classes; 769 since the production harvest of 2026-09-26 17:00 UTC added Delphinion, hammam and flatiron); pinned by fields/classify.py TABLE_SHA256.
